title: A person changes an answer by code, keeps it, and takes the kept answers away as a notebook that reproduces them; Home's model answers through tools
request: The owner's goal: Home serves people who want analysis and BI from their data; H7's plan text: tools query_data, make_chart, save_answer; edit controls change the plan without a model; saved answers export as a notebook that reproduces every saved answer.
spec: Package H7, part c: one give_answer step for every answer (rules, model tool, edit); controls (operation, split, time grain) applied by code; Save; GET answers/notebook as a zip of the notebook and the checked cleaned table; the model's three tools in the draft scope behind the draft guard, query_data telling the model only that an answer was given.
plan: One give_answer for every way an answer is given.
edits/edit_plan in home_query; save/edit/notebook routes; controls on the page.
home_notebook: the notebook runs each saved plan through dclab_core.query on clean.parquet and asserts the shown numbers.
The three tools, guarded; review adversarially.

decisions.decision: An edit is applied by code from a fixed list of controls; a value not offered is refused.
decisions.why: The plan says edits change the plan without a model; a free-form edit would be a new question, which the brief and the model handle.

decisions.decision: The notebook re-runs each plan with the same engine and asserts the numbers the chat showed.
decisions.why: 'Reproduces every saved answer' must be checked, not claimed; a changed table fails loudly.

decisions.decision: query_data returns to the model whether it answered, the answer's number and how many groups, never a value.
decisions.why: The person gets the numbers from code; no table value reaches the model.

decisions.decision: Only answers from the table in use go into the notebook; others are listed as left out.
decisions.why: The zip holds one table; an answer from another cannot be computed again from it.

change: dclab_rnd/draft/chat.py (give_answer, save_answer, edit_answer; query_data, make_chart, save_answer tools; guard); dclab_rnd/home_query.py (edits, edit_plan); dclab_rnd/home_notebook.py (new); dclab_rnd/draft/api.py (three routes); agentic/web/src/views/home.html (controls); tests.

findings.defect: After an edit, the original answer's menu showed the new value.
findings.scenario: Split by city on the plan answer: the first card's menu read 'city' while it still showed plans.
findings.cause: The select kept the chosen value.
findings.fix: The menu returns to its own answer's value; the change is a new answer below.
findings.test: checked on the real server (built-in browser)

findings.defect: Removing the time grain dropped an end date.
findings.scenario: A period ending 2025-06-30, edited to no grain, answered over all dates.
findings.cause: The period was kept only when it had a start.
findings.fix: Kept when it has a start or an end; only the grain goes.

findings.defect: The model's tool result told it how many small groups were hidden.
findings.scenario: Repeating a plan filtered on one hidden row and a moving threshold recovered that row's amount (12345.67) in forty calls.
findings.fix: query_data returns only whether it answered and the answer's number.

findings.defect: Two answers at once could swap numbers.
findings.scenario: Two edits at the same time: the first message pointed at the second answer, so its Save changed the wrong one.
findings.cause: The number was re-read as the list's length after the update.
findings.fix: The number set inside the update is used.
findings.test: review: traced by hand; the update sets n atomically

findings.defect: The guard's new checks had no test.
findings.scenario: Deleting the answer guard failed no test.
findings.cause: Tests called the tool functions directly.
findings.fix: A test runs the guard: off the analysis track, before the table is described, a missing answer.

measurements.name: The page on the real server
measurements.gate: an edit makes a new answer, Save marks it, the notebook downloads
measurements.result: Split by city answered below the plan answer; Saved shown; answers.zip downloaded (200, application/zip)
limits: by hand in the built-in browser

measurements.name: The notebook reproduces saved answers
measurements.gate: every saved answer reproduces; a changed table fails
measurements.result: 2 of 2 saved answers reproduced from the exported zip; a doubled amount column fails the check

outcome: A person can change an answer without typing, keep the answers that matter, and take them away as a notebook that computes them again and proves they match.
lessons: A claim like 'reproduces' belongs in the artefact as an assertion, so the person can check it too.
A tool's result to a model is a channel too: even a count of hidden groups leaks what the floor hides.
risks: Model-written sentences behind cited.py are not built; code templates answer.

Two answers on one table can be subtracted to show a hidden small group (a split, then no split); only the person sees it and could ask both questions anyway; a full fix is suppression across related answers (a change to H6's engine).
A median on a five-row group is one row's value: the engine's floor rule, which the controls make easier to reach.
The model's save_answer trusts the person asked (its description says so); the cost is an extra answer in the export.
